name: Dwight Prompt
cardDescription: Dwight is a prompt assistant that helps users craft better prompts for AI, enabling more effective and precise responses through improved prompt engineering.

name: TriggerNote
cardDescription: TriggerNote brings your notes into view when you open a matching website, keeping reminders in context. It works locally, with optional cloud sync.

name: Vidspawn
cardDescription: Vidspawn is a local-first screen recorder for macOS. Record, transcribe, search, and share videos using your own machine and cloud storage, with MCP support for AI agents.

name: Docspawn
cardDescription: Docspawn turns existing PDFs into reusable templates with AI-assisted fields. Connect forms, spreadsheets, or CRM data to generate branded documents and deliver them to the right inbox.

name: Sabi
cardDescription: Sabi is a platform that connects startups and businesses with vetted tech talent, offering a reliable source of skilled professionals to meet their technological needs.

name: HahuJobs Primary
cardDescription: HaHuJobs primarily offers services aimed at Ethiopian job-seekers, utilizing both online and assisted models. The platform is designed to facilitate the job search process across all employment levels.

name: Lunaria
cardDescription: Lunaria is a document intelligence platform that lets you ask your documents anything and get instant answers. No folders, no digging — just AI-powered answers from your PDFs, images, scans, and receipts.

name: Hey Mobile Store
cardDescription: Hey Mobile's website features a diverse array of laptops, computers, digital accessories, and smartphones, ensuring competitive pricing and a seamless, user-friendly shopping experience for customers.

name: Supabrain
cardDescription: Supabrain gives AI agents persistent memory across sessions and tools. It stores verified conclusions from past work so agents can recall useful context through a local-first, MCP-native workflow.
